assets.role: brand kit image showcasing design system style
assets.prompt: A professional design brand-kit dashboard layout presenting the design system of a pastel brutalist portfolio. It is divided into multiple visual sections on a single canvas, including: 1. Palette section showing pastel colors: lavender, dusty pink, soft green, orange, muted blue, with charcoal black outlines. 2. Typography section showcasing beautiful clean typography and headings. 3. UI components section displaying organic capsule buttons, icons, card shadows. 4. Hero composition slide showing polaroid card mockups and ambient light overlays. 5. Assets slide and mobile preview mockup. The design style is soft brutalism, extremely clean presentation, professional vector look, beautiful soft color harmony.
